title: Dy remembers Cua as public servant who always put Quirino province first

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III remembered late Quirino governor Dakila “Dax” Cua as a public official who consistently prioritized the needs of his province ahead of his own. In his eulogy at Cua’s necrological service for Cua on Monday, Dy said that he always considered Cua not only a friend but a younger brother in public service. Dy said Cua always addressed him “Manong Bojie”. Both legislators came from Cagayan valley. READ: Quirino governor dies at 48; remembered for 25-year public service “Kaibigan ko si Dax.
